name: Arkanoid II: Revenge of Doh
summary: Revenge of Doh is a sequel to the arcade classic Arkanoid, featuring the return of the dimension-controlling entity Doh aboard the massive starship Xorg. Players pilot the Vaus II spacecraft in a preemptive strike mission. This DOS port includes an enhanced graphic engine, improved sound and music, and expanded hardware support. The game offers multiple levels of brick-breaking action and includes a built-in level editor, allowing players to design and create custom level sets for extended gameplay.
